evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Joanna: 'And first off before we start, do you have any imported concerns that you also want to discuss on this call?' — asked before probing began. Customer: 'Not that, I can think of right now.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer raised no concerns in Section 2.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — customer raised no concerns to reflect back.

evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Joanna: 'How about boxes, do you plan us to move some boxes for you?' — This asks about boxes, NOT the full packing service offer ('Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'). Not asked.

Personalized: 'just considering the travel time in between as well just depending on traffic and of course the stairs on the second location' — both present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Joanna: 'It's all inclusive... The two men and the truck, all the wraps are protect your furniture... all of that is already included... no hidden fees of any type, no transportation fees, no stair fees, no credit card fees' and 'we only start the time. Once we arrive there at your pickup location... we just have a two and a half hour minimum. But once we go over the minimum we only charge in fifteen minute inter roles' — both fee transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Joanna: 'Does that make sense?' (to the pricing and minimums) — customer responds 'Yup.' However, no 'Does that feel fair?' specifically asked. The 'Does that make sense?' is followed by customer confirmation without rep over-talk. Partial credit score-adjacent, but the exact framing is not there.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Joanna: 'on time guarantee, if we run late on the time we schedule, we provide discounts for your move' — mentioned but discount terms vague ('provide discounts'). Not 'starts discounting immediately' or clear percentage/structure.

Missing: explicit 'no deductible / no fine print' framing and clarification that it's built into the rate (not an add-on). Partial.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Joanna does NOT ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. No loop closure on the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Joanna: 'Alright, do you have any other questions?' — This is the throwaway 'any questions?' form, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' version.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. Joanna does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Joanna: 'Alright, now that being said, Sean would you like our help for this move on Thursday?' — Asked plainly, no built-in out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Joanna: 'There's no risk and securing a spot as well. So if you need to make changes later all you have to do is just give us a call.' — Implies no-deposit / rate-lock but not explicitly stated as 'your rate is locked' or 'no deposit required to hold the booking'.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Joanna: 'So I'll go ahead and send you a confirmation email after our call. So this is already good and confirm for the first again if you need to make any changes just let us know.' — Date confirmed (Thursday, October 1st), email mentioned for confirmation. Missing: phone number confirmation, arrival window, crew size, addresses re-confirmed, crew notes about customer concerns. Partial.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, stories, rooms, parking, special items, box count) in a natural flow without feeling robotic, and anchored a personalized estimate with clear hourly pricing and bundle framing.
coaching_note: Move 'do you have any concerns?' from the opening to after pricing to establish genuine two-layer follow-up opportunities, and close Section 5 with 'Does that put those to rest?' before jumping straight to the final close.
